name: Vitória da Conquista

queries.query: Vitória da Conquista official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastro imobiliário prefeitura Bahia
queries.result: First-party discovery found the municipal Gerência de Cadastro e Lançamento, municipal georeferencing notices, and the municipal Geo360 pg_tileserv parcel service. The live service exposes cadastro.lote polygon metadata and public vector tiles.

queries.query: Vitória da Conquista cadastro territorial georreferenciado mapa parcelas prefeitura
queries.result: Portuguese first-party discovery found the Prefeitura/SEFIN cadastro imobiliário and georreferenciamento program, plus the official Geo360 parcel layer. Municipal material describes cadastral lot polygons and cartographic linkage; no owner or unsafe fields were retained.

officialSources.publisher: Prefeitura Municipal de Vitória da Conquista
officialSources.observation: Municipal Gerência de Cadastro e Lançamento is responsible for managing, updating, and maintaining the Cadastro Imobiliário Municipal.

officialSources.publisher: Prefeitura Municipal de Vitória da Conquista / SEFIN
officialSources.observation: Municipal notice documents cadastral updating and georeferencing work under SEFIN.

Live anonymous layer metadata identifies cadastro.lote as polygon geometry, stable integer id as the table identifier, EPSG:4326 metadata, citywide bounds [-40.984474182128906,-15.041089057922363,-40.6158447265625,-14.702041625976562], and the public vector-tile route.

requests.outcome: Municipal cadastral custodian page retrieved; no parcel geometry in the page.
Municipal georeferencing notice retrieved; it documents the local cadastral program, not a direct parcel response.
Current pg_tileserv index retrieved and inspected; cadastro.lote and related cadastral layers are publicly listed.
Public layer index retrieved; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe attribute request was used.

Layer schema retrieved: cadastro.lote, geometrytype Polygon, native id int4 described as unique table identifier, EPSG:4326 metadata, and citywide layer bounds. The schema lists unsafe fields, which were not requested for retention.

Bounded z17 vector tile around the immutable WUP point returned 253 parcel features. The exact WUP point was not inside a returned feature. This tile result is not evidence of citywide absence; the response was retained only in ignored tmp evidence and no raw attribute set was retained.

registryBasis: Local municipal cadastral custodian is evidenced by the Prefeitura/SEFIN Gerência de Cadastro e Lançamento and by the municipal Geo360 cadastral parcel service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal Geo360 cadastral lot layer; metadata bounds cover the Vitória da Conquista municipal service extent.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public cadastro.lote layer metadata and one bounded vector tile were verified; citywide completeness and parcel publication policy were not independently established.
coverageAssessment.cityCoverage: Not proven complete; exact-point tile returned no hit, which is not treated as absence.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Public geometry and native id are evidenced, but independent serial adapter qualification and coverage/completeness review remain outstanding.

scopeLimits: The immutable WUP point was preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested, logged, or retained.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because the inspected PBF is tile-local/clipped and its raw response contains source attributes beyond the safe allowlist.
Packet completion is not source integration, catalog admission, or runtime qualification.
remainingUncertainty: The municipal service, layer schema, CRS metadata, native id, and bounded geometry response are verified. It remains uncertain whether the public tile layer is complete across all municipal areas, whether tile geometries are unclipped at higher zooms, and how the source's internal cadastral identifiers should be interpreted operationally.
pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; retained exactly and not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
